page_title: GIR 3-2 BET | Girona v Betis 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+6' Michel prepares a substitution. Ivan Martin is replaced by Juanpe (Girona).
90+6' The substitution is prepared. Valery (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Artem Dovbyk.
90+5' Pablo Fornals (Betis) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+5' It must be a yellow card. It is. Yangel Herrera (Girona) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
90+2' 3 - 2 Goal! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 3:2.

90+2' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Rui Silva to get hold of the ball.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Yellow card. Pablo Torre (Girona) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
88' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Pablo Torre (Girona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Girona will take a corner kick.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
84' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Chimy Avila (Betis) gets a yellow card.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chimy Avila trots off the pitch and is replaced by Rodri (Betis).
82' Today's match ends for David Lopez who will be replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
82' Here is a change. Portu is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Torre (Girona).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Viktor Tsygankov departs the field of play to be replaced by Yangel Herrera (Girona).
79' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

79' This shall not pass! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Girona.
77' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Abner and he is replaced by Juan Miranda (Betis).

76' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Willian Jose (Betis) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Pablo Fornals. The score is 2:2.

75' The most active player in today's match is definitely Isco (Betis). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
73' The attendance for today's match is 12774.
71' Chimy Avila (Betis) leaps highest to meet the corner and heads from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
71' The ball goes behind for a corner. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but Rui Silva comes off his line to gather the ball.
65' 2 - 1 Artem Dovbyk (Girona) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
62' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. William Carvalho (Betis) replaces Nabil Fekir.
62' It is time for a substitution. Chimy Avila (Betis) is on for Ayoze Perez.
61' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
60' Jesus Gil Manzano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by David Lopez (Girona).
58' Girona are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
55' Ayoze Perez (Betis) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
55' Portu (Girona) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
54' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
52' Willian Jose (Betis) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
48' The cross into the penalty area from Pablo Fornals (Betis) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Manuel Pellegrini probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Chadi Riad. He is replaced by Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' 1 - 1 GOAL! Willian Jose (Betis) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:1.
45+2' The corner from Aleix Garcia (Girona) is intercepted by the defence.
45+1' Chadi Riad (Betis) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
41' Ivan Martin (Girona) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jesus Gil Manzano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
38' David Lopez (Girona) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
38' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Girona.
36' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Artem Dovbyk (Girona) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Rui Silva no chance!
36' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
35' The Girona players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
35' Referee Jesus Gil Manzano makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Girona. Let’s see what happens!
34' Surely that's handball by one of the Girona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

33' Portu clips a neat ball into the box towards Artem Dovbyk (Girona), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
31' Isco (Betis) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
29' The Girona players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.

26' Chance! Ayoze Perez (Betis) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Isco, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
24' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
24' Pablo Fornals (Betis) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) meets a cross inside the box, but Rui Silva wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
19' Pablo Fornals (Betis) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
15' Rui Silva (Betis) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
14' Rui Silva (Betis) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Portu, but Rui Silva displays great awareness to stop him.
11' Pablo Fornals (Betis) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
7' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Isco (Betis). Jesus Gil Manzano saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
6' Ayoze Perez (Betis) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
4' Nabil Fekir (Betis) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Willian Jose, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
3' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
Betis will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jesus Gil Manzano.
